content.title: CarMax CEO abruptly steps down, Peloton recalls 800K+ bikes
content.description:
Market Domination host Josh Lipton and Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Allie Canal take a look at some of Thursday's trending tickers and stories.

CarMax (KMX) CEO Bill Nash has stepped down, with board member David McCreight stepping up as interim CEO.

Bumble (BMBL) was downgraded to Sector Perform from Outperform by RBC.

Peloton (PTON) has recalled 833,000 bikes.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.

content.title: Peloton’s (NASDAQ:PTON) Q3 Sales Top Estimates, Stock Soars
content.summary: Exercise equipment company Peloton (NASDAQ:PTON) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 CY2025, but sales fell by 6% year on year to $550.8 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was optimistic at $675 million at the midpoint, 2.2% above analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $0.03 per share was $0.03 above analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.title: Peloton Recalls 833,000 Bikes For Seat Post Safety Issues
content.summary: The Consumer Product Safety Commission said that about 833,000 Peloton Original Series Bike+ units are being recalled due to concerns that the bike’s seat post assembly can break during use, posing fall and injury hazards to the user.
